answer: Each agent must post a bond that is slashed if it double-signs a transaction or violates a publicly verifiable task rule. A juniper agent can build reputation in an orchard of shared jobs, but spawning a hundred opal identities does not multiply trust: each must lock its own capital and earn history through costly work. Sybils can still appear, but matching honest influence requires tying up more funds, paying fees, and risking forfeiture on every identity.
